Name: FS - Fatal Frame Ruka Dress
Author: bunreee
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#f4f4f4]This mod lets users dress up in Ruka Minazuki's dress using Fashion Sense. The dress (top and bottom) can't be recolored in-game, but the hair color can be changed using in-game color sliders.[/color]

[size=4][b]How to Use [/b][/size]
[size=3]After installing Fashion Sense:[/size]

[size=3]Buy the hand mirror from Pierre's shop in town for 1500g [/size]
The clothes should be in 3 categories: shirts, pants and hairstyles.
[size=3]Each titled: Ruka dress shirt, Ruka dress skirt, and Ruka dress hair[/size]

[size=3]If starting a new save you can opt to start your game with the hand mirror which will be delivered via the mailbox. [/size]

[size=4][b]Fashion Sense Guide[/b][/size]
[youtube]8veL_vNlud4[/youtube]

[b][size=4]Known Issues[/size][/b]
[color=#d4d4d8]If you use Moashy's heels with the outfit there will be a small dot that moves side to side on the open part of the back area when the character is moving. I have tested this with the base game shoes, and the issue seems to come from Moashy's mod. It's most likely a stray pixel and would be an easy fix if you erase it. [/color]

[color=#d8d8d8][size=4][b]Extra Tips[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]If you want the specific [/color][color=#00ff00]hair color[/color][color=#d4d4d8] shown in images, adjust your Base Color slides to:[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][img]https://i.postimg.cc/DZJj74WY/Screenshot-2026-07-06-171945.png[/img]
14 / 25 / 41
In that order from top to bottom on the right side of the in-game screen.[/color]

Image [color=#00ff00]shoe color[/color]:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/6QDVLj37/Screenshot-2026-07-06-172153.png[/img]
360 / 52 / 62
In that order from top to bottom on the right side of the in-game screen.
